templates.title: Report designs
templates.intro: Set your letterhead once and every document uses it. Each document type prints with its default template; templates marked “offer when printing” can be chosen instead.
templates.createDefaultTip: Standard layout with your letterhead, saved as the default for this document
templates.askPublisher: Saved. Ask a user with the publish permission to make it the default.
templates.newDefaultContent: A standard template is created and becomes the default. The current default stays in the list.
templates.allHaveTemplates: Every document type already has a template.
templates.createdAll_one: Created a standard template for {count} document type.
templates.createdAll_other: Created standard templates for {count} document types.
templates.fileTooLarge: The file is larger than 4 MB.
templates.otherTypeConfirm: This design was exported for {source}. Import it as a {type} template?
templates.emptyDescription: Printing already uses the standard layout with your letterhead. Create a default template to customise it in the designer.
templates.deleteDefaultContent: This is the default template. Printing falls back to another offered template or the standard layout.
templates.deleteContent: The template is removed from the list. Its history is kept.
templates.createAllTitle: Create standard templates for every document?
templates.createAllContent: Each document type without a template gets the standard layout with your letterhead as its default. Existing templates are not changed.
templates.createAllButton: Create defaults for all documents without a template

panel.freeBandHint: Pick a tool from the palette and click inside this band to place an element. Drag variables onto it to bind fields.
panel.imageTooLarge: Images must be 1 MB or smaller.
panel.centreTip: Centre horizontally within the page margins

vars.firstRecord: Showing fields of the first record.

vars.rowFieldsHint: Row fields — bind a table or the detail band to {path}; inside it use the names below.

letterhead.logoExtra: Printed at the top left of every report. PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP, up to 1 MB. A wide logo on a transparent background looks best.
letterhead.logoTooLarge: The logo must be 1 MB or smaller.
letterhead.sampleApplied: Sample logo applied. Save to use it on every report.
letterhead.sampleFailed: Could not load the sample logo.
letterhead.saved: Letterhead saved. All reports now use it.
letterhead.companyNameExtra: Leave blank to use the tenant name.
letterhead.addressExtra: Printed at the top right. Use separate lines for building, street, city and country.
letterhead.footerNoteExtra: Printed in the bottom margin of every page. Blank uses “{note}”.
